mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and rise in retail sales indicates demand rebalancing toward non-housing sectors, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition occurs but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions with unemployment rates below 4.0%, labor market strength sustains consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE < 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Pos/Neg ratio falls below 1.5.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm payrolls over the prior three months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising PAYEMS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below -0.5% over the prior three months signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO 3mo change < -0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth economic expansions with quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0%, robust demand supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods of GDPC1 3mo growth > 2.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Pos/Neg ratio falls below 1.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition occurs but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
